payload.core_mechanism_summary: Two-state DP over k steps: u (current matches end) and v (mismatch). x = count of good cyclic shifts, y = bad. Updates: u = u*(x-1)+v*x; v = u*y+v*(y-1).
payload.rationale: Solution classifies all cyclic shifts of start as matching end (x) or not (y). Then DP on two states (match/mismatch) over exactly k split operations, exploiting the group structure of splits as cyclic shifts.
